source.available_owner: the existing warehouse_stock.available row, shared with return disposition and native return corrections
source.on_hand: available plus this same source's active transfer reservations
source.reserved: active source transfer reservations at the origin
source.in_transit: dispatched less received and lost units, attributed to the origin
source.separate_fulfillment_source: a replacement fulfillment source has distinct ownership; its absolute quantities cannot be added to this warehouse

identity.resource_id: authorization and journey linkage, never an independent balance or anchor
identity.movements: immutable source-owned IDs; return-event, return-disposition and transfer namespaces derive stable IDs from original source operations and unit/location identity
identity.snapshots: immutable absolute observation ID with all covered movement IDs captured in the same native transaction
identity.corrections: retain a link to the actual ancestor movement for the same unit, including across native event stages without a stock effect

ledger.initial_anchor: one absolute observation per physical stock key
ledger.later_absolute: compare with movement history; never add as a delta or silently rebase
ledger.covered_movements: retained as history but not applied again above an anchor that already includes them
ledger.replay: same ID and original source digest preserve one movement across restart; conflicts fail closed
ledger.chain: per stock key, monotonic ledger_seq and previous_digest link immutable nonpersonal stock cores
ledger.integrity_limit: local digests detect inconsistent data; they do not authenticate an external warehouse or adversarial database administrator

authority.conflicts: append a scoped FIELD_OWNER_CONFLICT discrepancy and preserve the existing owner
authority.source_adjustment: recordMovement is trusted synthetic fixture administration, not a merchant-facing physical adjustment endpoint
authority.recovery: restore quarantine blocks imports and ownership changes; read-only source lookup and existing ledger views remain available

privacy.subject_link: tenant_id, store_id, resource_id on every commerce table
privacy.movement_minimum: inventoryMovementCore plus tenant/store/resource and chain_digest; retain exact quantities and original source digest while removing personal journey/evidence details
privacy.owners: retain variant/location/field/source identity without personal metadata
privacy.read_after_erasure: direct resource access is denied; another authorized resource may read shared aggregate quantities without seeing the erased journey
privacy.external_copies: warehouse source databases and caller copies require separate operator handling

storage.rollback: retain original source identities, anchors, covered IDs and chain cores; do not delete an observation to force reapplication

tests.targeted_fault: actual isolated location-inventory module adds a repeated absolute snapshot to the balance, violating the literal ten-unit oracle
tests.author_execution: none; integration owns the bounded native invocation and independent reviews
